dublinCore.dc:title: 116 HR 2154 IH: Digital Taxonomy Act of 2019
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Soto (for himself and Mr. Davidson of Ohio) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce

form.official-title: To authorize additional appropriations to the Federal Trade Commission to prevent unfair or deceptive acts or practices relating to digital tokens and transactions relating to digital tokens, and to require a report to Congress on the Commission’s actions related to digital tokens.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Digital Taxonomy Act of 2019.

section.header: Authorization of appropriations to prevent unfair or deceptive acts or practices relating to digital tokens
section.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Federal Trade Commission $25,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024 to prevent unfair or deceptive acts or practices in transactions relating to digital tokens pursuant to section 5 of the Federal Trade Commission Act (15 U.S.C. 45).

paragraph.text: the term digital token means a digital unit—

subparagraph.text: that is programmed with rules that govern its creation, supply, ownership, use, and transfer, where such rules are designed to resist modification or tampering by any single person or persons under common control;
that has a transaction history that—

clause.text: is recorded in a distributed, digital ledger or digital data structure in which consensus is achieved through a mathematically verifiable process; and
after consensus is reached, is designed to resist modification or tampering by any single person or persons under common control;

subparagraph.text: that is capable of being transferred between persons in a decentralized fashion without an intermediate custodian; and
that is not a representation of a financial interest in a company or partnership, including an ownership or debt interest or revenue share; and
means a representation of economic, proprietary, or access rights that is stored in a computer-readable format; and
does not include a store of value.

section.text: Beginning one year after the date of enactment of this Act and each year thereafter, the Federal Trade Commission shall transmit a report to the Committee on Energy and Commerce of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate of—

paragraph.text: any actions taken by the Commission relating to unfair or deceptive acts or practices in transactions relating to digital tokens;
the Commission’s plan to prevent unfair or deceptive acts or practices relating to digital tokens; and
any recommendations by the Commission for legislation that would to improve the ability of the Commission and other relevant Federal agencies—

subparagraph.text: to further protect consumers from unfair or deceptive acts or practices in the digital token marketplace; and
to promote the competitiveness of the United States and promote innovation of businesses in the global digital token sector.

section.text: Nothing in this Act shall supersede the authority of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission nor prevent the treatment of digital tokens as commodities subject to the Commodity Exchange Act (7 U.S.C. 1a et seq.).
